domains_limits_valid.name: domains_limits_valid
domains_limits_valid.value:
("domains"."max_mailboxes" IS NULL OR "domains"."max_mailboxes" >= 0)
        AND ("domains"."max_aliases" IS NULL OR "domains"."max_aliases" >= 0)
        AND ("domains"."default_mailbox_quota_bytes" IS NULL OR "domains"."default_mailbox_quota_bytes" > 0)
        AND ("domains"."max_mailbox_quota_bytes" IS NULL OR "domains"."max_mailbox_quota_bytes" > 0)
        AND ("domains"."total_quota_bytes" IS NULL OR "domains"."total_quota_bytes" > 0)

domains_rate_limit_valid.name: domains_rate_limit_valid
domains_rate_limit_valid.value: ("domains"."rate_limit" IS NULL) = ("domains"."rate_period" IS NULL) AND ("domains"."rate_limit" IS NULL OR "domains"."rate_limit" > 0)

mail_imports_owner_valid.name: mail_imports_owner_valid
mail_imports_owner_valid.value: ("mail_imports"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mail_imports"."organization_id" IS NULL) OR ("mail_imports"."user_id" IS NULL AND "mail_imports"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mail_imports"."mailbox_id" IS NOT NULL)

mailboxes_rate_limit_valid.name: mailboxes_rate_limit_valid
mailboxes_rate_limit_valid.value: ("mailboxes"."rate_limit" IS NULL) = ("mailboxes"."rate_period" IS NULL) AND ("mailboxes"."rate_limit" IS NULL OR "mailboxes"."rate_limit" > 0)

spam_list_entries_one_target.name: spam_list_entries_one_target
spam_list_entries_one_target.value:
("spam_list_entries"."organization_id" IS NULL AND "spam_list_entries"."domain_id" IS NULL AND "spam_list_entries"."mailbox_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("spam_list_entries"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND (("spam_list_entries"."domain_id" IS NULL) <> ("spam_list_entries"."mailbox_id" IS NULL)))
